aspect: Justice in a language he does not speak
description: Interpreters for indigenous languages in criminal proceedings are a legal requirement and frequently unavailable, which interacts directly with POL-001's confession statistics.
energy_note: Confessing in Spanish to a document he cannot read.

description: Triqui, Mixtec and Zapotec workers move to Sinaloa and Baja agricultural camps for the season, in conditions that are documented and poor - internal migration with many of the features of international migration.
energy_note: A migrant worker without leaving the country.

description: Births registered late or not at all produce the documentation problems in DOC-001 at higher rates, so the exclusion is administrative before it is anything else.

aspect: SCENE - the interpreter who does not come
description: The hearing proceeds in Spanish. He speaks Triqui. The public defender says he understands enough, and he nods, because nodding is what he has learned to do in rooms like this. He is asked whether he understands the charge and he says yes.
energy_note: Says yes, having understood roughly a third of it.
